card.name: Linking words before a city name
card.fires_on: Commas, prepositions and separators such as "in", "of", "to" or "|" right before a city or place name is expected, mostly in US geography and history prose or address lists.

modes.label: Commas in city lists
modes.description: A comma after one city in a list of stops, where another city comes next.
modes.example: , starting in Miami, making stops in Hollywood, Fort Lauderdale, Deerfield Beach, and West Palm Beach, continuing north to Tampa, Orlando, Jacksonville<<,>>

modes.label: Prepositions before a place
modes.description: "in", "of" or "from" just before a city or district name such as New York, Manhattan or London.
